title: Shattered Serpent Veil
description: A vibrant green snake with orange eyes coils on the right side of a shattered mirror or glass surface, surrounded by floating white petals. On the left, flowing colorful silk fabrics in pink, purple, and gold patterns swirl through the broken glass fragments against a dark background.
prompt: A surreal scene of a vibrant emerald green snake with orange eyes coiled on the right, surrounded by floating white petals, positioned next to flowing colorful silk drapery in swirling patterns of pink, purple, orange and gold on the left side. The entire image is viewed through a dramatically shattered mirror or glass pane with sharp cracks and floating shards, dark moody background with soft ethereal lighting.
